text.card: A red giant 2,357 parsecs away, 11 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 3, give 0.91 solar masses and 11.0 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,814 K at its surface.
